rules.name: xoga750-03-run-history-and-steps
rules.sql: SELECT h.processing_type, h.position, h.import_as, h.status, h.username, h.uploaded_by, h.start_time, h.completion_time, h.upload_data_date, h.upload_for, h.original_file_name, h.file_name, h.file_size FROM opera.oga_bulk_upload_history h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.start_time >= :since AND lower(coalesce(h.processing_type, '') || ' ' || coalesce(h.position, '') || ' ' || coalesce(h.import_as, '')) LIKE ANY (ARRAY['%xtr%', '%gpc%', '%neovest%']) ORDER BY h.start_time DESC LIMIT 200

WITH ex AS ( SELECT DISTINCT l.execution_id FROM opera.pipeline_execution_step_log l WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.created_timestamp >= :since AND lower(l.step_name) LIKE ANY (ARRAY['%xtr%', '%gpc%', '%alias%', '%trade%', '%consolidat%', '%resolve%']) ) SELECT l.execution_id, l.created_timestamp, l.step_number, l.step_type, l.step_name, l.input_row_count, l.output_row_count, l.rejected_row_count, l.warning_count, l.execution_duration, l.step_status FROM opera.pipeline_execution_step_log l JOIN ex ON ex.execution_id = l.execution_id WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant ORDER BY l.created_timestamp DESC, l.execution_id, l.step_number LIMIT 1500

SELECT e.execution_id, e.created_timestamp, e.step_number, e.row_number, e.error_code, e.error_message, e.root_cause, e.suggested_action FROM opera.pipeline_execution_error_log e WHERE e.tenant_id = :tenant AND e.created_timestamp >= :since AND lower(coalesce(e.error_message, '') || ' ' || coalesce(e.root_cause, '')) LIKE ANY (ARRAY['%sequence%', '%trade%', '%prefix%', '%master%', '%alias%', '%gpc%', '%xtr%']) ORDER BY e.created_timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

expect.reason: the tester ran Web XTR and GPC Trade after :since
each run writes step log rows
